lines.t: I was broke in my soul, now I walk like I’m whole
Devil wanted my life, but YahuShua in control
From the trap to the altar, all the pain turned gold
He said, “Come, keep faith,” now my heart won’t fold
Earnest expectation, yeah, I’m back on go
If He said it, then He meant it, I’ma stand ten toes
From the mud, from the blood, from the streets so cold
He said, “Your faith made you clean,” now I move like I’m bold
I was stuck in that darkness, heavy chains on my brain
Like the leper in the Scripture, everybody knew my shame
Kept my distance from the crowd, I was dying in the rain
Said, “If You will, Lord, You can take away this pain”
He reached through the smoke, put His hand on my stains
Didn’t send me to religion, sent me straight to His name
No priest, no clique, just the Lamb that was slain
Gave me Hidden Manna, now I’m feasting in the flameTen boys on the corner, all heard the same call
“Go show yourself,” they moved, then the sickness had to fall
But only one spun back, threw his pride at His feet
That’s the one that got the word, “Your faith made you complete”
I ain’t tryna be the nine that just vanish in the street
I’ma be the one that circles back, worship on repeat
